say:0:1611029301:1.text: Considering Gervan's legs have miraculously healed and his ties to the Adamant Syndicate, his entire testimony about the headmaster's death is now suspect. He must be treated as a prime suspect and investigated thoroughly.
say:0:1611029301:1.source_cn: 鉴于格墨文腿伤已经痊愈，且他与黑金商会有非常紧密的联系...

say:1:1611029302:1.text: Compared to some random flying monster, Gervan seems far more likely to be the real killer.
say:1:1611029302:1.source_cn: 比起那只飞行魔物，作为黑金商会的棋子，格墨文更有可能是...
